The '''Vor Deo system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vor Deo]].
